section: Educational Psychology · Ch10 — Memory, Forgetting & Transfer
subject: Educational Psychology
stem: A person fluent in driving a manual (stick-shift) car in India struggles and repeatedly stalls when first driving a car with the gear and clutch positioned differently abroad, because the OLD habitual pattern actively interferes with the new one. This is an example of:
explanation: Negative transfer occurs when previously learned habits or skills actively interfere with and hinder the learning or performance of a new, somewhat different skill.
